[[File:Rainbow_berry_bush.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A rainbow berry bush on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].]]
The '''rainbow berry bush''' was a plant that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], in particular in the forests of the [[Jiberah Plains]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The [[Rainbow berry|fruits]] produced by the rainbow berry bush were used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] to prepare [[Wistie Fest pie]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|75|rainbow berry}}</ref> The plant was featured on [[Klepa Laeel]]'s painting [[Rainbow Berry Bush]].<ref name="SWG:P6">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Publish 6: "The Imperial Crackdown"}}</ref>
